title: 기준금리와 시장금리

summary.definition: 기준금리는 중앙은행의 정책 신호이고, 시장금리는 성장·물가·재정·수급·위험 프리미엄을 반영해 거래에서 정해진다.
summary.mechanism: 정책금리 변화는 단기 자금시장에 빠르게 전달되지만 장기금리는 미래 정책 기대와 채권 공급·수요에 따라 다르게 움직인다.
summary.example: 기준금리가 동결되어도 장기 국채금리가 상승할 수 있다. 시장이 미래 재정 공급이나 인플레이션 위험을 새로 가격에 반영했기 때문이다.
summary.counterScenario: 기준금리 인하를 모든 대출금리와 자산가격의 즉시 하락으로 해석하면 전달 시차와 스프레드를 놓친다.

researchEvidence.statement: The FRED Inflation Expectations release provides separate series for expected inflation and real interest rates across maturities; the release is a data reference and does not make the measures interchangeable.
researchEvidence.invalidation: Series frequency, maturity, observation date, construction method, and revisions must be preserved; no current value is embedded in this article fact.

researchEvidence.statement: The Federal Reserve's policy report separates policy-rate decisions, inflation, labour-market conditions, real interest rates, and capital investment; a policy signal is therefore an input to several transmission channels rather than a one-variable price forecast.
researchEvidence.scope: Official monetary-policy reporting and transmission framing
researchEvidence.invalidation: This source is a dated policy report, not a timeless causal estimate or a guarantee that a rate change will move every maturity, credit spread, asset, or economy in the same direction.

researchEvidence.statement: The New York Fed defines the natural rate of interest, r-star, as the real short-term interest rate expected to prevail when the economy is at full strength and inflation is stable. It is unobservable and must be estimated rather than read directly from a market price.
researchEvidence.invalidation: Do not treat a single model estimate, the SEP longer-run policy rate, or a TIPS yield as the true r-star; each has a different definition and uncertainty.

researchEvidence.statement: New York Fed research compares model-based r-star estimates with market measures and warns that long-horizon real yields can contain time-varying risk and liquidity premia. Market-model disagreement is therefore evidence to investigate, not a mechanical replacement of one estimate by the other.
researchEvidence.invalidation: The research does not establish that one estimator will dominate in every sample or regime; preserve maturity, model, observation date, and confidence interval.
